class.name: SuperpositionConfig
class.brief_description: Reusable Superposition property schema and update policy.
class.description: Save as a resource shared by matching server/client scenes. Select supported target properties through [Superposition] checkboxes, then edit type, quantization and smoothing on each rule. This initial reliable gameplay state slice provides change suppression and update scheduling rather than a general prediction or RPC framework.

members.member: Automatic (0) polls selected properties. Pushed (1) skips target capture until [method Superposition.mark_dirty] is called. Baselines and schema/session changes still capture automatically.
Visible objects leave at Radius + Hysteresis; hidden objects re-enter at Radius. Prevents interest boundary churn.
Radius around a Node3D target used for explicitly supplied observer positions. Zero disables spatial relevance filtering. Unspecified observers remain visible.
Native scheduling service weight from 1 to 16. Higher values favor this object under a peer update budget; waiting lower-priority flows retain their scheduling position.
One to 32 enabled typed properties, with no duplicate names. At most 32 total rules.
Server capture and client application rate from 1 to 30 Hz. Catch-up does not emit bursts.
